notes.title: 🌊 Tides of Tomorrow - New Game Reveal
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We've been incredibly touched by your passion and enthusiasm. Your support means the world to us, and we're thrilled to have shared that journey with you.

Today, we're excited to unveil a new project that we've poured our hearts and souls into. It embodies the same spirit of creativity and storytelling that you've come to love from DigixArt.

We hope you will welcome and wishlist our new baby-project - Tides of Tomorrow! 🌊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678080/Tides_of_Tomorrow/

Watch our reveal trailer!

[previewyoutube=yVjNGNZcqHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
In Tides of Tomorrow your every choice matters. A deadly plastification is slowly killing all life, and it's up to you to find a cure, explore floating platforms, and navigate through various communities. But you won’t be alone! Your friends' and other players' decisions will directly impact your story, adding a thrilling layer of unpredictability.

We hope you'll join us on this new adventure and continue to be a part of our growing community. Your feedback and support mean everything to us, and we can't wait to share more details with you soon.

Thank you for being amazing fans!

Warm regards,
DigixArt Studio

notes.title: Lost in Harmony Coming to Nintendo Switch and PC!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157944/279f0549490f0dd8daddd01dc44869ddca1281bc.png
 
Put on Your Headphones and Embark on a Fantastic Melodious Journey to Help Kaito Save Aya

We're proud to announce that Lost in Harmony will release on Nintendo Switch™ and PC / Steam on June 21, 2018.

Lost in Harmony is a fantastic musical runner that flawlessly blends a deep and emotional story into a rhythm game. This harmonious audio odyssey narrates the adventures of Kaito and Aya, two teenagers who brave many hardships and travel together across a beautiful, hand-drawn dreamworld while dodging obstacles and staying in harmony with the music.
 
Watch Lost in Harmony Nintendo Switch teaser:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIRKJqlYFDM
Lost in Harmony Nintendo Switch and PC features include:
 
- Rhyme and run: Experience music in a new way with the combination of choreographed musical rhythmic tapping and running

- Strong story lore: Discover the emotional and gripping story from the co-creator of Valiant Hearts

- Musical experience: Moving and original soundtrack from well-known composers and singers

- Hand-drawn graphics: Travel through 30+ breathtaking painted environments

- Customization features: Customize your character’s clothes, hat, headphones and skateboard

To stay up to date with the latest news and information regarding Lost in Harmony, please visit the official website, follow the game on the official Facebook page and also follow the game on Twitter.
